name: no mirame, cuando lloro
source:
a failed suicide attempt forces a nearly homeless girl into being involuntarily committed. maybe it'll help her get back onto her feet?

[From [url=https://pupn1k.itch.io/nomirame]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个几乎无家可归的女孩自杀未遂，被迫接受住院治疗。也许这能帮她重新站稳脚跟？
